notes: Phase 1 eccentricity/radius/diameter via src/algorithms/paths/radii.rs. All three are BFS-from-every-vertex (calling existing SP-006 `distances`). Karate (34v): eccentricity ≈ 92.7 µs (34 calls to distances at ~2.5 µs each = ~85 µs + overhead, lines up). Radius/diameter share the eccentricity scan plus a single min/max. A bespoke single-pass would shave ~3-5 µs but Phase-1 minimal favours simplicity. Mode-aware (`IGRAPH_IN/OUT/ALL`) variant and a Dijkstra-weighted version land with SP-001.
